arguments.command:
cd $PWD; rm .git/hooks/*.legacy; git commit -qm "feat(thread): report an answer's stop reason and whether its run used tools" 2>&1 | grep -v Passed | tail -3; git add src/conversation.ts src/run.test.ts && git commit -qm "fix(conversation): continue a response cut off by max_tokens instead of asking for a summary

A response that stops with \`length\` and no tool call ends the agent loop,
but the model did not choose to stop. Send a continuation (tools allowed)
up to 3 cut-offs in a row and within the timeout; post partial text marked
as cut off; past the limit, post an error suggesting a higher
model_max_tokens." 2>&1 | grep -iv "passed\|unstaged\|restored" | tail -3; cp /tmp/conv.ts src/conversation.ts && cp /tmp/runtest.ts src/run.test.ts && git add src && git commit -qm "fix(conversation): make the summary re-prompt neutral about completion

It no longer claims the work is done or forbids tools: it asks what was
done, what is left and any errors, and lets the model finish first." 2>&1 | grep -iv "passed\|unstaged\|restored" | tail -3; git add README.md && git commit -qm "docs: describe what happens when a response hits model_max_tokens" 2>&1 | grep -iv "passed\|unstaged\|restored"| tail -3; git status --short; git log --format='%h %s%n%b' -4 | grep -v '^$'
